issue.title: test_files_ctrl_j_scrolls_page_anchor_to_top times out under full-lane load, passes focused
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_deck_spread_pilot.py::test_files_ctrl_j_scrolls_page_anchor_to_top`
- **Repro:** `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_deck_spread_pilot.py::test_files_ctrl_j_scrolls_page_anchor_to_top -q -p no:randomly`

Failed once in the full 3-worker `just check` lane (`wait_for(...) timed out after
5.0s`) while the host sat at load1 30-45 over a 32-minute suite run, then passed
on the same tree in a focused rerun (part of a 21-passed focused batch in
~24s). Classic load-timing flake; no code overlap with the
monitor_failed_count_leak diff under verification.

Observed at HEAD `eba6b80d0` during monitored `just check` run `5gky1hb2f6rp`
(tool run `f612c7e28035a677677bc1779111476b`).

task_type_fields.evidence: Fail rate 1/2 observed: failed once in the full 3-worker lane at load1 30-45 (5.0s wait_for timeout), passed once focused on the identical tree (~24s batch). Serial focused rerun passes; parallel full-lane run fails.

evidence.note: Proposed independently by sase-19x.4 notes #2-3 and sase-19x.9 note #5: test_files_ctrl_j_scrolls_page_anchor_to_top timed out under loaded parallel widgets/check runs, then passed focused on unchanged tree; same node and load sensitivity.

sase-1b1 land agent, master 372ecc97c3: looping the whole tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/ dir at -n 6 failed this node on attempt 7 of 7 (wait_for(_files_scroll_on_separator_anchor) timed out after 5.0s at test_deck_spread_pilot.py:156). The same loop on a pre-sase-1b1 worktree (9c4d104aff~1) failed it on attempt 8 of 12. Focused and whole-file runs (serial and -n 4) passed 5/5. So it is load-timing only and predates the deck-views epic; it also showed up in 2 of about 10 small parallel batches.

Corroboration from epic sase-1b2 phases: sase-1b2.11 note #2 saw tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_deck_spread_pilot.py::test_files_ctrl_j_scrolls_page_anchor_to_top fail in about 1 of 4 ISOLATED runs (5s scroll-settle wait_for timeout) on the clean base tree, and sase-1b2.16 note #1 saw it again. So it is not only a full-lane-load flake. Recorded by sase-1b2.land.

payload.description: Sibling deck pilot flaking in isolation on the same scroll-settle wait_for timeout; likely shared settle-wait root cause

evidence.note: Independent sighting proposed by sase-1bt.6 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1, 2026-09-28 02:27 EDT): test_files_ctrl_j_scrolls_page_anchor_to_top failed once under a loaded multi-file run during the tools-deck-cards phase and passed on an isolated rerun on the same tree. Relayed by sase-1bt.land; focused rerun on master 916156f887 passes (1 passed in 2.0s).

payload.entry: Phase sase-1i5.7 (deck-scroll-settle) converted your final wait to the shared wait_for_anchor_scroll helper (tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/_deck_settle.py) alongside the sase-1br fix, but could NOT verify it here: the node fails at setup with the pre-existing content-layout wire schema-5 RuntimeError (src/sase/core/content_layout_wire.py:227), reproducing identically on the clean tree - recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP on sase-1i5.7. Leaving you open for the land agent / owner to verify once that env issue is fixed; the shared helper already covers your wait.
